text:
2 days ago During the past few weeks there have been numerous reports of black bears in this corner of Orange County, including several near Washingtonville's Center,. three in the Whispering Hills Development in Chester and one on the Heritage Trail. This is the time of year when adult animals who have had Spring offspring are allowing their growing babies to wander farther and start to search for food on their own. This can be dangerous if a human happens to walk between the Momma Bear and Cubs. Black bears do not otherwise bother people as long as you stay alert and do not bother them Experts recommend that if you are in a wooded area you make some noise so they have time to check on their offspring and know they are not in harm's way. While there has been an increase in reported sightings it is impossible to know for sure whether there are more bears in the area or just more people reporting them. Other forest creatures are traveling more now too, so keep an eye out for baby fawns as they hopefully learn how to cross our roads safely, and fox kits as well, especially if you have small dogs and cats or chickens in your yard.
